name: pets-driven
description: Forward agent lifecycle events to the pets-driven desktop companion so the bound pet expresses agent work state.

interface.longDescription: pets-driven bundles Codex lifecycle hooks and a shared hatch workflow so pets can react to prompt, permission, and turn-completion events for the working directory Codex is using.
